rationale: Several papers contribute substantive new evidence on the formation and evolution of ultraluminous X-ray sources, including their progenitor systems and accretion processes. Papers 2401.14157, 2302.10605, 2202.11158, 2602.14876, 2311.04733, and 2211.00014 explore aspects such as supermassive neutron stars, observational progress, variability, magnetic fields, and winds in ULXs, but the question is not fully settled.
